topics.title: BGP neighbor states and session troubleshooting (Idle, Active, Established)
paraphrases: The BGP finite state machine states and the usual reasons a session stays in Idle or Active instead of reaching Established.

concepts.learning_objective: The BGP finite state machine states and the usual reasons a session stays in Idle or Active instead of reaching Established.

topics.title: eBGP multihop and peering with non-directly connected neighbors
paraphrases: Why and how eBGP sessions are allowed to form across more than one hop, for example between loopback addresses.

concepts.learning_objective: Why and how eBGP sessions are allowed to form across more than one hop, for example between loopback addresses.

topics.title: BGP verification commands (show ip bgp, show bgp summary)
paraphrases: The show commands used to read the BGP table and check neighbors and their session states.

concepts.learning_objective: The show commands used to read the BGP table and check neighbors and their session states.

topics.title: BGP best path selection with weight and local preference
paraphrases: How the BGP best path algorithm ranks routes, starting with the Cisco weight and then local preference for outbound path choice.

concepts.learning_objective: How the BGP best path algorithm ranks routes, starting with the Cisco weight and then local preference for outbound path choice.

topics.title: AS path loop prevention and AS numbers (2-byte and 4-byte ASN)
paraphrases: What the AS_PATH attribute records and how it prevents loops, plus the size of the 2-byte and 4-byte AS number spaces.

concepts.learning_objective: What the AS_PATH attribute records and how it prevents loops, plus the size of the 2-byte and 4-byte AS number spaces.

topics.title: BGP well-known communities (no-export, no-advertise)
paraphrases: What the well-known no-export and no-advertise communities do to the propagation of a route.

concepts.learning_objective: What the well-known no-export and no-advertise communities do to the propagation of a route.

topics.title: iBGP next hop and advertisement rules (next-hop-self)
paraphrases: How iBGP handles the next hop of routes and which peers iBGP-learned routes are passed on to.

concepts.learning_objective: How iBGP handles the next hop of routes and which peers iBGP-learned routes are passed on to.

topics.title: BGP route filtering with prefix lists
paraphrases: Defining ip prefix-list entries and how permit and deny statements filter BGP routes by prefix.

concepts.learning_objective: Defining ip prefix-list entries and how permit and deny statements filter BGP routes by prefix.

topics.title: AS path access lists and regular expression filtering
paraphrases: Filtering BGP routes by the ASes in their AS path with an as-path access-list.

concepts.learning_objective: Filtering BGP routes by the ASes in their AS path with an as-path access-list.

topics.title: Applying route maps to BGP neighbors
paraphrases: Using route maps as BGP policy and attaching them to a neighbor in the inbound or outbound direction.

concepts.learning_objective: Using route maps as BGP policy and attaching them to a neighbor in the inbound or outbound direction.

topics.title: BGP route flap dampening
paraphrases: How bgp dampening penalises and suppresses flapping routes and how to turn it on.

concepts.learning_objective: How bgp dampening penalises and suppresses flapping routes and how to turn it on.

topics.title: BGP route reflectors and cluster ID
paraphrases: How route reflectors remove the need for an iBGP full mesh, what the cluster ID is for, and design considerations for deploying them.

concepts.learning_objective: How route reflectors remove the need for an iBGP full mesh, what the cluster ID is for, and design considerations for deploying them.

paraphrases: Splitting a large AS into sub-ASes that appear as one AS to the outside, to simplify iBGP.
